observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor stage with a light wooden floor and dark blue pleated curtain backdrop
observation.formation_and_space: soloist moving across the center stage area, turning and traveling in various directions
observation.posture: upright torso with deep pliés in a wide stance, knees bent outward and weight frequently shifted
observation.footwork: rhythmic stamping of feet with ankle bells, alternating heel-toe lifts, light steps, and quick turns synchronized to the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held in graceful curved positions, hands forming specific mudras (hand gestures), gesturing near the chest, face, and extended outward
observation.hips_and_torso: torso remains upright and controlled while maintaining low plie positions; subtle shifts corresponding to the footwork
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent spins and turns, low squatting/sitting position on the floor at 02:53, and dynamic level changes between standing and deep plie
observation.costume_and_props: traditional classical Indian dance costume with maroon and gold pleated skirt, yellow blouse, gold jewelry, hair adorned with white flowers, and ankle bells
observation.cannot_infer: low video resolution prevents seeing precise toe-heel articulation details

signature_moments.what: Deep plié in wide stance with one arm extended high overhead and the other extended to the side
Quick single-leg lift with foot tapping while arms gracefully gesture near the face
Descending into a low seated squat on the floor and rising back up while maintaining hand gestures
